messages:
erin_sales: Lighthouse returned their RFI. They want a concise capability matrix (hosted/dedicated/private), HSM behavior, 4-week Dedicated trial pricing + overage policy, and a POC milestone plan. PDF in drive: https://drive.google.com/lighthouse-rfi. Need SMEs by EOD.

raj_engineer: Clarify: they list 28k tokens/sec peak in tests. Aggregate across flows. Also request KV cache survive restarts.

katie_se: Hosted: no HSM, fastest onboarding. Dedicated: reserved GPUs, sticky routing for KV. Private: VPC + BYO-HSM. Will draft matrix + two perf configs (latency vs cost).

michael_ops: Private + HSM path: peering & tunnel ~1.5w, provisioning 1w, smoke/tests 1w, tuning 2w => ~5.5w. Persistent KV requires stateful routing and more RAM.

sam_sales: Proposed 4-week Dedicated trial: $15k reserved + standard token rates; optional annual commit with 20% discount; 1-week burst credit. Overage = token rates after reserved capacity.

legal_bot: Security: refuse unlimited audit access. Propose 90-day audit retention for POC, standard DPA language, encryption in transit/at rest. I'll draft appendix.

erin_sales: Tasks: @katie_se full matrix/spreadsheet; @raj_engineer perf profiles; @michael_ops confirm infra lead times; @legal_bot draft security appendix; @sam_sales pricing slide + SOW bullets. Target send to Lighthouse by 2149123600. :thumbsup:
